faq.q: What can I make with Aidreamcapes?
faq.a: Short video ads, product and unboxing videos, white-background photos, lifestyle photos, model photos and social ad images. Everything starts from a photo of your product.
A clear photo of the product you sell. A phone photo on a plain background works well. Only upload photos you own or have permission to use.

faq.q: How long are the videos, and what sizes can I get?
faq.a: Videos are 6, 10 or 15 seconds. Choose 9:16 for TikTok, Reels and Shorts, 1:1 for feeds, or 16:9 for wider placements.
